angle: What the producer said, and the one project already known

sources.title: Konami Planning 'Second and Third Waves' of New Silent Hill Games
Konami is already thinking about the next wave of Silent Hill games
Silent Hill, Gravity Rush director's Bokeh Game Studio is reportedly casting for a new horror game
Expect plenty more Silent Hill over the next few years, as Konami has plans for 'second and third waves' of new games in its revived horror series

claims.claim: IGN published a piece headlined: Konami Planning 'Second and Third Waves' of New Silent Hill Games
claims.evidence: Konami is planning "second and third waves" of new Silent Hill games, according to producer Motoi Okamoto.

claims.claim: Eurogamer published a piece headlined: Konami is already thinking about the next wave of Silent Hill games
claims.evidence: Silent Hill producer Motoi Okamoto says Konami is looking at "a number of projects" after the first wave of new Silent Hill games. Read more

claims.claim: Eurogamer published a piece headlined: Silent Hill, Gravity Rush director's Bokeh Game Studio is reportedly casting for a new horror game
claims.evidence: It looks like Bokeh Game Studio, founded by Keiichiro Toyama, who directed the original Silent Hill and created Siren and Gravity Rush , is working on another horror game. Read more

claims.claim: PC Gamer published a piece headlined: Expect plenty more Silent Hill over the next few years, as Konami has plans for 'second and third waves' of new games in its revived horror series
claims.evidence: "We're currently looking at a number of projects," says producer Motoi Okamoto.

claims.claim: Silent Hill producer Motoi Okamoto told Famitsu that Konami must think about second and third waves of games.
claims.quote: we're not stopping here; we must think of the second and third waves

claims.claim: Okamoto said Konami cannot share details but is looking at a number of projects.
claims.quote: We can't share specific details, but we're currently looking at a number of projects.

claims.claim: Okamoto said one remake was not enough, because a single release might make people think development would be cancelled again.
The interview appeared in Famitsu issue 1965 and reached English-language outlets through Game Observer.
claims.evidence: IGN: interview featured in Famitsu Issue 1965 (via Game Observer).

claims.claim: The first wave included the Silent Hill 2 remake, Silent Hill f and Silent Hill: Townfall, which came out last month.
claims.evidence: IGN lists the first wave; Townfall arrived last month.

claims.claim: Eurogamer gave Silent Hill: Townfall four stars out of five.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer: awarded it four out of five stars.

claims.claim: Okamoto said persuading Konami's executives to back new entries was hard, especially after the cancellation of Hideo Kojima's Silent Hills in 2015.
claims.evidence: PC Gamer summarises Okamoto on convincing executives after the 2015 cancellation.

claims.claim: Bloober Team is working on a remake of the original Silent Hill, announced by Konami in June 2025.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer: Bloober Team is now working on a remake of the original Silent Hill, announced in June 2025.

claims.claim: Konami revived the series in 2022 by announcing several projects at once, including the Silent Hill 2 remake, Silent Hill f and Townfall.
claims.evidence: Eurogamer: resuscitated in 2022 with several announcements at once.

claims.claim: It is not known whether NeoBards Entertainment and Screen Burn Interactive, the studios behind Silent Hill f and Townfall, will return to the series.
claims.evidence: PC Gamer: whether NeoBards and Screen Burn will return is yet to be decided.

claims.claim: PC Gamer notes the series has had three new entries in as many years after roughly a decade without one.
claims.evidence: PC Gamer: three new entries in as many years after roughly a decade.
